results.name: Zeno's Achilles & The Tortoise
results.assertion: Sum_{i=0}^n (1/2)^i converges to 2 in Archimedean metric within finite delta_t.

results.name: Russell's Antinomy
results.assertion: Unrestricted comprehension schema is unsatisfiable under classical bivalence.

results.name: Barber Paradox (Russell Universal Restriction)
results.assertion: Universal quantifier domain contradiction: forall x, S(B,x) <=> not S(x,x).

results.name: Tarskian Liar Paradox
results.assertion: Truth predicate cannot be defined in object language without stratified hierarchy.

results.name: Curry's Paradox (Unbounded Contraction)
results.assertion: Contraction rule (A => (A => B)) => (A => B) causes explosive inconsistency without substructural restriction.

results.name: NOPOT Inductive Decrement Ranking
results.assertion: Well-founded ranking metric V(s)=s > 0 decreases strictly at every step: V(s_{t+1}) < V(s_t).

results.name: Lamport Byzantine Agreement (3m+1)
results.assertion: Symmetric consensus without digital signatures requires N >= 3m + 1.

results.name: Dirichlet Pigeonhole Collision Bound
results.assertion: Injective mapping f: [N+1] -> [N] is mathematically unsatisfiable.

results.name: Burali-Forti Ordinal Super-Maximality
results.assertion: Von Neumann ordinals form a proper class, strictly barring a universal ordinal set.

results.name: Cantor's Cardinal Power Set Anomaly
results.assertion: No surjective mapping exists from any set S to its power set P(S).

results.name: Berry Least Unnameable Integer
results.assertion: Kolmogorov complexity naming bound generates semantic diagonal paradox.

results.name: Grelling-Nelson Heterological Antinomy
results.assertion: Semantic predicate application to itself produces isomorphic Russell negation.

results.name: Yablo's Non-Circular Sequence
results.assertion: Infinite well-founded chain of strictly monotonic negative assertions is inconsistent.

results.name: Zeno's Dichotomy (Runway Paradox)
results.assertion: Continuous integration of constant velocity over finite compact interval [0, 1] is bounded.

results.name: Zeno's Arrow at Rest
results.assertion: Instantaneous velocity is the derivative limit dx/dt, non-zero even though measure of singleton {t} is 0.

results.name: Ship of Theseus Identity Persistence
results.assertion: Identity over time defined by continuous causal graph trajectory rather than static part set equality.

results.name: Sorites Heap Boundary Paradox
results.assertion: Truth value transitions smoothly across continuous membership function mu in [0, 1].

results.name: Two Generals Communication Link
results.assertion: Common knowledge cannot be attained in finite rounds over lossy channel.

results.name: FLP Asynchronous Crash Failure
results.assertion: Bivalent configurations always have non-terminating critical execution path in asynchronous network.

results.name: Banach-Tarski Non-Measurable Ball Decomposition
results.assertion: SO(3) free group contains non-abelian free subgroup F_2; decomposition pieces lack Lebesgue measure.
